notes.title: Tray Fix
notes.summary: Bringing MediaDesk back from the tray now opens the window properly.

items.title: Restoring from the tray
items.text: With "Hide to the tray when minimized" on, clicking the tray icon (or opening MediaDesk again) only put it back on the taskbar as a minimized button. It now opens the window straight away, ready to use.
